name: Admin Document Create
description: Create a new admin document via Markdown paste mode or file upload mode, with title, live preview, and an optional private client note opened from doc-client-note-open. The modal groups email subject, email body, and WhatsApp in sequence; applying it keeps the draft in the form and creation persists all three fields without adding them to the PDF. The optional client/project association remains available through ClientAutocomplete plus ProjectSelect, including inverse project-to-client cascade and folder suggestions.
knownGaps: Cover toggles and template-style selection are carried by the same payload but are not asserted independently in this flow.
